business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) Clinical Workflow Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law foundation with customary law and U.S.-inspired corporate statute)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (Amended 2003)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (RMI P.L. 2012-20), as amended; Business Corporations Act 1990, Part XVI regarding registered agent duties; AML/CFT Regulations 2015; Registered Agents Licensing Regulations; Financial Transactions Reporting Act

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae / professional background summary for each member of management team
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and senior officers against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions, BIS Entity List, and RMI Financial Intelligence Unit advisory lists. PEP determination follows FATF 40 Recommendations; enhanced due diligence (EDD) triggers for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, adversarial media, or unusual source-of-wealth patterns. The registered agent must maintain executed screening records for a minimum of five years after termination of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Attorney General, Registrar of Business Associations — RMI Corporate Name Reservation Administration (operated through International Registries, Inc. licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate records and statutory name must be in English using Latin alphabetical characters without diacritical marks or special symbols. Non-English names must be transliterated into English phonetic equivalents and approved by the Registrar; Marshallese-language names are acceptable if rendered in Latin script.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of Business Associations within 10 business days, attaching the original rejection notice and a revised proposed name. The Registrar shall issue a decision within 5 business days; a successful appeal grants a fresh 30-day reservation. A pending reservation may be extended before expiry for up to 30 additional days by paying a USD 100 extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for the statutory registered office using the registered agent's address; virtual office does not satisfy economic substance expectations for locally sourced income and cannot be listed as the principal clinical data processing location. No physical operations are required for a non-resident, tax-exempt Marshall Islands business corporation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (5% probability per incorporation year); inspections are targeted at registered agents and their AML/CFT compliance records, not at foreign beneficial owners or virtual premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office annual fee
AML/CFT initial due diligence and UBO screening fee
Notarization of identity/address/proof bundle (per document set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public in country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization/authentication of due diligence bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Embassy or Consulate of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal, share certificates and minute book

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, 1990 (as amended), codified in Title 26 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; primary formation and governance provisions include Section 9 (Articles of Incorporation), Section 20 (Certificates of Correction), Section 25 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), Section 37 (Organization of Corporation) and Section 46 (Board of Directors), supplemented by the Registrar of Corporations Non-Resident Business Corporation Practice Directive.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed in duplicate; the duly endorsed Certificate of Incorporation issued under the seal of the Registrar constitutes conclusive evidence of formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required under the BCA for a non-resident Business Corporation. The corporation may commence business upon the issuance of at least one share for valid consideration. No escrow deposit, capital maintenance account or paid-up capital attestation is required at formation; share capital records are maintained as book entries in the corporate register.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the subscription of 100,000 ordinary shares in the Corporation be accepted and the Secretary is directed to issue corresponding share certificates. FURTHER RESOLVED: that the registered office at the office of the licensed statutory agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, and such agent's appointment are ratified and adopted. FURTHER RESOLVED: that [Name] is appointed President/Chief Executive Officer, [Name] is appointed Secretary, and [Name] is appointed Treasurer/Chief Financial Officer, each to serve until the next annual meeting or until successors are qualified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (via the RMI online corporate registry portal or a licensed RMI registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability inquiry against the RMI corporate name database. If the proposed name is available, file Form CORP-01 Name Reservation Request and remit the USD 50 reservation fee. The name must end with a statutory corporate designator (e.g., 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or 'Limited') and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any reserved, registered or foreign-qualified name in the RMI registry.
required_dossiers: Form CORP-01 Name Reservation Request
Draft Articles of Incorporation (name clause only)
Passport copy of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the name as confusingly similar, the applicant may file a written rebuttal demonstrating distinctiveness or resubmit with a modified name; the Registrar must issue a written determination within 5 business days of the curative filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations via a licensed RMI registered agent; notarization by an RMI notary public or a Marshall Islands consular officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in English in the statutory form. The Articles must state the corporate name, registered office address, name and address of the registered agent, statutory purposes covering ISIC 6201/NAICS 511210 software publishing and electronic medical record platform services, authorized share structure (e.g., 1,000,000 no-par shares), permitted indemnification and limitation-of-liability clauses, and the names and addresses of incorporators. The incorporator must execute the instrument before a notary or consular official; the registered agent's written consent must accompany the Articles.
required_dossiers: Original and duplicate signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Form CORP-02 Consent of Registered Agent
Incorporator information sheet
Power of attorney authorizing the registered agent to file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles are returned for correction, file a Certificate of Correction under BCA Section 20 or amend and resubmit the Articles without forfeiture of the original filing fee; stale notarial execution dates require fresh notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation in duplicate through the licensed registered agent together with the government filing fee of USD 250 (plus the agent's handling fee). The Registrar timestamps the instrument upon receipt; the incorporation becomes effective on the date and time of endorsement unless a later effective date is stated in the Articles. A receipted fee acknowledgement is returned to the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Duplicate executed Articles of Incorporation
Cover letter from registered agent
Bank wire or cheque confirmation of the USD 250 government fee
Certificate of Name Reservation (Form CORP-01 approval)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the filing is queried for incomplete exhibits, the registered agent has 10 business days to submit a curative response; if the matter remains unresolved, the applicant may resubmit the full filing with a letter explaining the non-prejudicial nature of the omission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Certified Extracts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Corporations Registry), Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory statutory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under official seal, establishing the corporation's legal personality. The registered agent should simultaneously request certified true copies of the Articles and a Certificate of Good Standing for downstream banking, licensing and tax registration. The corporate identification number and incorporation date must be recorded in the corporation's statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Filed Articles of Incorporation (stamped duplicate)
Government fee receipt
Request form for certified copies and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is not issued within the service standard, the registered agent may escalate in writing to the Registrar for administrative priority; a lost Certificate is replaced upon submission of an affidavit of loss and payment of the replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Adoption of Bylaws and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Internal corporate action by the initial board of directors; no governmental filing is required, but executed records must be retained at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting of the incorporators or execute a unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting. The board adopts Bylaws governing share transfers, board composition, officer roles, indemnification and meeting procedures; accepts the incorporator's share subscription; elects the initial directors; and appoints officers pursuant to the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution. Share certificates are issued and entered in the share register.
required_dossiers: Draft Bylaws
Signed organizational consent or minutes
Share subscription agreement and issued share certificates
Officer and director acceptance forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural defect in the organizational meeting is cured retroactively by a ratification resolution or unanimous written consent signed by all directors and shareholders, effective nunc pro tunc.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of Registered Office and Registered Agent Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the licensed registered agent's consent is recorded on the corporate file and that the registered office address (street, post office box and island) appears accurately in the registry records. If any change occurs, file Form CORP-06 Notice of Change of Registered Office and/or Registered Agent within 30 days; the new agent's consent must accompany the notice, together with the USD 25 filing fee.
required_dossiers: Form CORP-06 Notice of Change (if applicable)
Consent of the incoming registered agent
Confirmation of the street address of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar contests the agent's licensing status, the corporation must appoint a substitute registered agent without delay and file the corrected consent; failure to maintain a registered agent may lead to administrative dissolution, which is cured by reinstatement upon filing and fee payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Identification Number and Non-Resident Tax Status Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Revenue and Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Business Tax Registration Form (Form T-01) to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN). Declare the corporation's status as a non-resident Business Corporation deriving no Marshall Islands source income. Obtain written confirmation of the applicable tax treatment: no corporate income tax on non-RMI-source revenue, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax on non-RMI dividends, royalties or interest. Activate the electronic tax filing account for any required informational returns.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of Articles of Incorporation
List of directors, officers and ultimate beneficial owners
Certificate of Good Standing
Form T-01 Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TIN application is queried, provide certified English translations and notarized identity documents for beneficial owners; if processing exceeds 15 business days, escalate in writing to the Commissioner of Revenue for administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: General Business License and Digital Health Data Processing Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business License Division, Department of Finance and Treasury, with technical clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services for medical data processing activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a General Business License application under the Business Licensing Act 1990 within 30 days of issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation if the corporation maintains any physical office, local employees or contracts with RMI healthcare providers. Classify the activity as ISIC 6201 (computer programming) / NAICS 511210 (software publishing). Pay the annual license fee scaled to expected gross revenue. Request the 'Digital Health Data Processing' endorsement, which requires evidence of EMR platform security controls, data localization or cross-border transfer safeguards, and compliance with applicable health-record confidentiality standards.
required_dossiers: General Business License application form
Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
TIN certificate
Local tax clearance declaration
Description of the EMR SaaS platform and data security controls
Passport copies of directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A denial may be appealed to the Business License Appeal Board within 30 days of the decision; an incomplete application may be amended once without additional fee, and a temporary license may be issued pending final health and environmental clearances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Division, Department of Finance and Treasury, Republic of the Marshall Islands, in coordination with the Ministry of Health and Human Services for medical-data-related endorsements
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License under the Business Licensing Act 1990 with a Digital Health Data Processing Endorsement (ISIC 6201 / NAICS 511210 – Electronic Medical Record Clinical Workflow Software)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Environmental Registration (conditionally exempt from a full Environmental Impact Statement under the RMI EIA Regulations 1996): office-based SaaS software development with no industrial effluent requires only a completed Environmental Registration Form; a full EIA is mandatory only if a physical data center, standby power plant exceeding 500 kVA, or medical-waste handling facility is later established.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero point-source industrial wastewater discharge; office wastewater to municipal sewer must meet RMI-EPA water quality limits (BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6–9); HVAC refrigerants must be non-ozone-depleting; emergency backup generator emissions limited to US EPA Tier 4 standards (NOx ≤ 0.20 g/kWh and particulate matter ≤ 0.02 g/kWh); end-of-life servers, batteries and electronic waste must be segregated and exported to a certified recycling facility in accordance with the RMI Solid Waste Management Regulations 2013.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate from the RMI Fire Safety Inspectorate, including automatic fire suppression in server/equipment rooms (FM-200 or Novec 1230), portable extinguishers, unobstructed egress and annual testing records; structural load and building occupancy certification for telecommunication equipment spaces issued by the responsible Majuro urban development authority; occupational workplace clearance under the RMI Occupational Health and Safety Code covering workstation ergonomics, indoor air quality, electrical safety (NFPA 70 compliance) and emergency evacuation plans.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Customs and Tax Administration, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro Atoll); customs filing is processed through the ASYCUDA World single window at https://www.rmicustoms.org. Corporate franchise administration is handled by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, with registry services operationally administered through the Association of the Marshall Islands (AMI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The RMI abolished its national income tax and therefore maintains no statutory TIN or VAT ID regime for income or consumption tax purposes. A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) incorporated under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act must: (1) obtain its certificate of incorporation from the Registrar of Corporations (AMI), which serves as the entity's sole statutory identifier; (2) file an annual report and pay the annual government franchise fee (minimum US$200) to maintain good standing; (3) register with the RMI Customs and Tax Administration only if it physically imports goods into the RMI; and (4) register as an employer with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration (MISSA) only if it hires RMI-resident employees. A pure offshore EMR SaaS licensor with no RMI payroll, physical office, or import activity is not required to procure any local tax identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No RMI check-the-box, entity-classification, or hybrid-mismatch election exists because the RMI has no income tax to elect into. Non-resident domestic BCs automatically enjoy statutory exemption from RMI income, withholding, estate, and gross-receipts taxes under the Business Corporations Act and are excluded from the scope of the former Income Tax Act. Owners subject to U.S. federal taxation may independently file IRS Form 8832 or Form 8858 to classify the RMI entity for U.S. purposes, but that constitutes a U.S. federal reporting position and not an RMI statutory election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No_Indirect_Tax_System — the RMI does not operate a VAT, GST, or general sales-and-use tax regime. Its only indirect fiscal instruments are customs import duties, selective excise on alcohol/tobacco/fuel, and the passenger departure (green) tax; none applies to offshore SaaS or EMR cloud services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A — no VAT/GST system exists, so there is no turnover threshold, no registration threshold, and no obligation for non-resident SaaS suppliers to register, charge, or remit indirect tax regardless of revenue volume.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandate exists for e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping in the RMI. Commercial invoices for EMR SaaS subscriptions may be issued freely in any format without fiscal authorization. Physical imports are cleared electronically through ASYCUDA World at the port of entry with a customs import declaration and payment of applicable tariffs; this clearance mechanism does not extend to digital services.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Conceptually inapplicable — with no VAT/GST system, there is no 0% export rate to claim, no zero-rating certificate to obtain, no input-tax credit to substantiate, and no indirect tax refund mechanism. Cross-border supply of EMR clinical workflow software from a non-resident RMI BC is de facto outside any RMI consumption tax, and no application, prior approval, or registration is required. If physical hardware is later exported from RMI territory, no export duty is levied and no VAT refund procedure exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) — required only where physical goods depart RMI territory; not applicable to cloud-delivered EMR software
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill — mandatory for tangible export cargo; not applicable to pure digital SaaS transactions

Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment receipt — evidencing offshore receipt of subscription fees; recommended for the entity's contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation and AML banking file
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The RMI levies no VAT or export tax, so no zero-rating fraud, clawback, or retrospective VAT assessment is legally possible. Enforcement exposure is limited to: (1) RMI Customs Act violations for physical imports, where false declarations, undervaluation, or smuggling attract forfeiture of goods, duty-evasion penalties, and criminal fines or imprisonment; (2) Business Corporations Act violations, where failure to pay annual franchise fees or submission of materially false annual reports exposes the BC to strike-off, certificate revocation, and director or officer liability; and (3) banking provenance review, since RMI law imposes no exchange controls or mandatory FX repatriation deadline and the 180-day parameter referenced in this dossier is a banking-documentation convention rather than a statutory mandate. Non-resident BCs exporting SaaS are not subject to RMI income-tax audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Banking supervision is conducted by the Marshall Islands Banking Commission under the Ministry of Finance. Because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, monetary policy is effectively delegated to the U.S. Federal Reserve, and the Banking Commission acts as the licensing and prudential regulator for locally licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands has no independent fiat currency and no central bank foreign exchange control mechanism. Both current and capital account transactions are fully convertible in practice because the U.S. dollar is legal tender and freely circulates. There are no statutory restrictions on profit remittance, dividend distribution, or repatriation of invested capital. A foreign-owned Business Corporation may remit profits without exchange control approval, subject solely to compliance with anti-money laundering and banking documentation requirements. The practical limitation is not convertibility but correspondent banking due diligence and the need for a credible banking relationship to execute USD-denominated wires.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no export proceeds surrender rules and no mandatory conversion ratios in the Marshall Islands. The use of the U.S. dollar as domestic currency means export receipts are already denominated in the functional currency; no foreign exchange repatriation obligation or conversion requirement is imposed. Exporters may retain all export proceeds in their local bank accounts or deploy them offshore without central bank approval.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. There is no domestic fintech electronic money institution licensing framework in the Marshall Islands. A foreign offshore EMI cannot obtain a direct settlement account with the local clearing system without a physical licensed banking presence. In practice, offshore EMIs are used only as ancillary payment collection channels, not as primary treasury concentration vehicles. Any EMI that touches Marshall Islands clients must comply with the Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Prevention Act, but the absence of a digital banking charter makes a fully regulated onshore EMI account untenable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners must generally provide original or notarized identification documentation. Bank of Marshall Islands historically requires physical presence or a formal notarized appearance before a recognized notary for corporate account opening; remote interviews may be accepted on a case-by-case basis for reputable foreign corporate clients, but the Board resolution and signatory mandate must be certified by a qualified witness. There is no statutory remote-onboarding guarantee, so the safe assumption is that at least one director or an authorized officer must appear in person or before a notarized agent recognized by the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore business corporation with nominee director or nominee shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of directors and shareholders, ultimate beneficial ownership declaration, source of funds evidence for each controlling principal, audited financial statements or signed capital introduction letter, and legal opinion confirming the corporate veil and beneficial ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical software revenue originating from high-volume cross-border SaaS transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed SaaS master subscription agreement, HIPAA/BAA framework documentation, merchant processing statements, customer due diligence list of licensed medical providers, and a compliance narrative mapping each inbound payment to an identifiable patient or clinic contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial capital injected from a third-country jurisdiction without banking history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth report, bank reference letter from the remitting institution, board resolution authorizing the capital injection, proof of economic substance or intended medical software operations, and a written treasury policy explaining the expected fund flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to jurisdictions flagged by the Financial Action Task Force or with correspondent banking restrictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, procurement contracts with licensed medical software vendors, end-user attestations, and a negative-media and sanctions screening report prepared by a licensed compliance service provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital should be wired in USD via SWIFT MT103 to the corporate account at Bank of Marshall Islands. The remittance instruction must cite a purpose code consistent with direct investment or capital contribution; since the Marshall Islands does not maintain a standard purpose-code registry, the bank will rely on the stated narrative 'injection of paid-in capital for business corporation operations.' Supporting documentation must include a board resolution, a share subscription letter, and a beneficial ownership chart. The remitting bank should be recognized and not on a correspondent banking restricted list to minimize clearing delay.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements should be executed through the domestic bank using SWIFT MT103 for vendor payments and licensing fees, and by irrevocable commercial letter of credit routed through a U.S. correspondent bank for larger hardware or software procurement. Local clearing is limited; no CHIPS or Fedwire direct access exists on-island. All USD payments are ultimately settled through U.S. correspondent banks, so treasury must maintain same-day balance monitoring and obtain MT202 for interbank reimbursement where required.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forward referencing CMS or European rates for unsettled U.S.-dollar isolated jurisdictions
Cross-currency swap entered into through a licensed U.S. or Asia-Pacific prime broker
Plain vanilla USD interest rate swap
Zero-cost collar combining USD put and call options

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax filing under Sections 106 and 107 of the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted through the appointed Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April each calendar year; the first filing is due on 30 April of the year following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing after 30 April attracts a penalty of USD 100; continued non-filing or non-payment for two consecutive annual cycles permits the Registrar to administratively strike off or dissolve the company after notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a private, non-resident, tax-exempt Marshall Islands Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act; mandatory independent audit arises only if the entity becomes a licensed bank, trust, insurance company, or a publicly listed/regulated entity, or when required by a secured lender or investor agreement
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is mandated by the Business Corporations Act; financial statements, if prepared, are commonly presented in accordance with IFRS or US GAAP, and books of account must be sufficient to present a true and fair view of the company's affairs

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Registered Agent confirms and updates Ultimate Beneficial Ownership data in the AML/CFT due-diligence file whenever a share transfer occurs and annually in support of the Annual Report cycle; RMI AML/CFT rules require the agent to verify and maintain current UBO information, and the Registrar may access such records upon lawful request but no public UBO filing is made
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and share ledger
Minute Book of shareholder and board resolutions
Registered Agent's UBO and AML/CFT due-diligence file

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400–US$1,000 per annum for registered office/agent and standard corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$0 if no statutory audit is required; voluntary certified audit typically US$5,000–US$15,000 depending on transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (non-resident domestic corporation; no corporate income tax on income derived outside the Marshall Islands and no tax on non-resident domestic corporations' worldwide profits)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Marshall Islands income tax; no capital gains tax, no alternative minimum tax, no branch remittance tax; annual fixed franchise fee based on authorized share capital is the only recurring government charge

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Filing (BCA Annual Return form for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations) submitted through the RMI Registrar of Corporations online portal via a licensed registered agent
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation; not tied to the fiscal year-end, and fiscal year may be freely elected

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name exactly as per Certificate of Incorporation and the RMI Business Corporation Act (BCA) registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the registered name in English and the unique BCA number; no tax identification number is separately issued for NRDCs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical address of the licensed RMI registered agent with authority to accept legal process.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations must maintain a local registered agent; the agent submits the annual report and fee on behalf of the company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Registered Office Address in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address, city, and trial jurisdiction within the RMI where the registered agent is situated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not use a P.O. Box only; provide the full physical address. A virtual office maintained by the agent is acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of each director and officer, including full legal name, nationality, residential address, and date of appointment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals may serve without RMI presence; no requirement for local directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value or no-par value designation, and classes of shares issued.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This information determines the annual franchise fee; beneficial owner information must be separately provided to the registered agent under the RMI Beneficial Ownership Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Declaration of Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the corporation is a non-resident domestic corporation and does not carry on any commercial, industrial, or professional activity within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be affirmed by a director or officer. If the company physically operates in the RMI, it forfeits exempt status and may become subject to local taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Report attracts administrative late fees and the annual franchise fee may be increased by 10%; continued noncompliance leads to automatic revocation of the charter, strike from the RMI register, loss of good standing, and monetary penalties up to US$1,000 per calendar quarter of delay.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Marshall Islands does not impose dividend withholding tax on distributions made by a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double tax treaty is in force for the Marshall Islands with major economies; therefore treaty relief is not available. A claimant seeking confirmation of tax-exempt status may request a Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, or a certificate of non-resident domestic corporation status from the RMI Registrar for presentation to foreign tax authorities, but no domestic Form NRA102 or TRC protocol applies. The company should rely on the absence of RMI source income and the exempt identity to support foreign tax treaty applications in the shareholder's jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on royalties and debt interest paid to non-residents is 0%. Treaty rates are not applicable due to the absence of income tax treaties; a 0% domestic rate applies to both royalties and interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable – the Marshall Islands has not enacted mandatory transfer pricing documentation thresholds for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations; no Local File or Master File requirement in USD. However, if the entity becomes subject to Economic Substance Regulations in RMI for a relevant activity, it must maintain adequate accounting and operational substance records evidencing core income-generating activities in the RMI.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The RMI Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) impose a substance requirement on RMI entities, including Non-Resident Domestic Corporations, conducting certain relevant activities. EMR SaaS may fall within the 'Holding Company', 'Headquarters', or 'Intellectual Property' categories depending on whether the business holds medical software IP, executes material management decisions, or earns income from licensing/exploitation of intangibles in the RMI. An annual ESR notification must be filed, and the company must demonstrate adequate physical presence, employees, expenditure, and core income-generating activities in the RMI proportionate to the activity. Failure to satisfy ESR results in financial penalties and potential striking-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation with no physical presence or activity in the Marshall Islands while substantially managing the business (board meetings, employee oversight, cloud infrastructure, and revenue generation decisions) from a high-tax jurisdiction such as the United States or an EU member state, leading foreign tax authorities to re-characterize the company as a tax resident and assess unpaid corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI administrative penalties for false declarations and BCA violation: fines up to US$10,000, cancellation of corporate status, and disqualification of the entity from RMI registry. Foreign revenue authorities may impose back taxes, interest, accuracy-related penalties up to 75% of understatement, and CFC or managed-entity assessments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in a sham tax arrangement may have the corporate veil pierced for fraudulent trading and may be held personally liable for the company’s foreign tax liabilities. In serious cases, director travel bans may be issued and extradition or imprisonment of up to 5 years can arise under foreign tax fraud statutes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Beneficial Ownership Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file a beneficial ownership statement with the registered agent or furnishing false, misleading, or incomplete information about the natural persons who ultimately own or control the EMR SaaS company, in violation of the Marshall Islands Beneficial Ownership Act (as amended).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties of up to US$50,000 per violation; directors and officers may be fined individually; the company may be struck off the registry and prohibited from transacting business. The RMI Registrar may also share beneficial ownership information with foreign authorities through tax information exchange agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for fines if the company fails to pay, are barred from serving as director of any RMI company for a period of 5 years, and may be subject to arrest warrants resulting in detention and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing subscription payments from medical clinics through Stripe Billing and Bank Transfer without conducting proper customer due diligence, OFAC/PEP screening, or maintaining an AML compliance program as required for financial services, allowing proceeds from sanctioned jurisdictions, fraudulent medical schemes, or misrepresented entities to flow through the RMI account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering Act, penalties include financial sanctions up to US$100,000 per infraction, asset freezing, forfeiture of funds, and suspension or cancellation of payment processing or business licenses. Correspondent banking relationships and Stripe merchant accounts may be terminated globally.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors identified as 'culpable officers' for failure to prevent money laundering may be criminally liable, required to pay restitution of laundered funds, subject to travel bans pending extradition, and face imprisonment up to 10 years.
